There were also instructions to reduce the order for "returned stock" (80 in t018 and 25 in t029), but these were not applied to specific item lines (ladders or lamps) in the provided history, and typically "returned stock" adjustments are handled separately or reduce a general total rather than specific line items unless specified. Total items: 215 + 700 = 915.
